game.title: Middle-earth: Shadow of Mordor
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG set in Mordor, where the ranger Talion, bound to a wraith, hunts the uruk army, from Monolith Productions (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive), released 2014-09-30. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Talion's path through Mordor and the hidden story achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Warchiefs, Captains and Branding
chapters.summary: Branding uruks, turning bodyguards, death threats, power struggles, riots and taking down the five Warchiefs.

chapters.title: Legends, Artifacts, Ithildin and Forge Towers
chapters.summary: The bow, dagger and sword Legend missions, Artifacts and their memories, Ithildin and the Forge Towers.

chapters.title: The Wilds, Hunts and Outcasts
chapters.summary: Survivalist and Hunting challenges, Outcast rescues, Vendetta missions, freeing slaves and caragors, and using the wildlife.

chapters.title: Combat, Abilities and Runes
chapters.summary: Strike From Above, Detonate, executions, rune slots and high-level runes.

chapters.title: Lord of the Hunt (DLC)
chapters.summary: The Lord of the Hunt campaign with Torvin: Beastmaster Warchiefs, new beasts and the Test of the Wild.

chapters.title: The Dark Lord Campaign and Test of the Ring (DLC block)
chapters.summary: A later block of achievements: challenging the Dark Lord, building Forge Towers in Udun, One Ring missions and the Test of the Ring.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); written subpages are only Achievements and trophies, Table of Contents and Upgrades, and the Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls and Runes pages are linked but not written. No dedicated "shadowofmordor" Fandom wiki exists (the API returned HTTP 404). shadowofwar.fandom.com answers the API under "Middle-earth: Shadow of Mordor", with about 22 linked pages; lotr.fandom.com also has a page with about 61 links. Names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Firebird" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 241930. 11 of 74 Steam achievements are hidden. The 13 achievements listed from "A Short Introduction" (a new hunt with Torvin) to "The Hunt is my Mistress" (Test of the Wild) were grouped as the Lord of the Hunt campaign by schema position; that name comes from the "Hot Flashes" description. The 10 listed last, from "Betrayed" (hidden) to "Lord of the Ring" (Test of the Ring), were grouped by schema position as one more DLC block; its name is not in the data, so the chapter is described by what the achievements say. The other 10 hidden ones (such as "Ratbag the Great and Powerful", "The Hammer Falls" and "The Tower Crumbles") sit in the main story chapter.
